title: Kishu demo collection — decision record
scope: An authored record of consequential choices and observed tool outcomes. It is not a raw transcript or private reasoning trace. Generated art and fictional interactions replace the earlier source-media study.
reference: The user's approved cinematic direction and expanded public-demo brief.

events.title: Three different product experiences
events.decision: Build an original MMO concept, a dark simulated trading dashboard, and a contrasting workshop site.
events.why: Show Kishu across storytelling, dense product UI and a booking flow.
events.alternatives: Keep each fictional and avoid external transactions.
events.outcome: The three isolated demo scopes were assigned.

events.title: Replace the earlier third-party media
events.decision: Exclude prior media, derivative screenshots, acquisition scripts and old records from the public snapshot.
events.why: The user's chosen release uses generated assets and a new parentless history.
events.alternatives: Recursive deletion was blocked by policy; a non-destructive move into ignored .work/excluded-pre-release succeeded. No old media had been pushed.
events.outcome: Earlier media is outside the release file tree.

events.title: Keep the cinematic composition
events.influence: Kishu design guidance; existing approved layout
events.decision: Use ink blue, ivory type, brass controls and the new fictional Veldrift world.
events.why: Retain the visual quality the user liked while replacing the source material.
events.alternatives: This was a scoped replacement; no new user-selected visual comp is claimed.
events.outcome: The new page has three original destinations and a Wayfarers feature.

events.title: Generate ten composition-specific images
events.decision: Generate six Veldrift paintings and four Stillroom editorial images from text-only prompts, then encode WebP at original dimensions.
events.why: Artwork belongs in the layout: desktop copy needs negative space, while mobile needs a portrait composition.
events.alternatives: No third-party images were used as reference inputs; originality does not claim uniqueness or trademark clearance.
events.outcome: Ten generated outputs were inspected and their prompts, hashes and dimensions recorded.

events.title: Build with separate write boundaries
events.influence: Kishu router; user's saved model roles
events.decision: Assign MMO, Meridian and Stillroom implementation to three separate coding workers.
events.why: Independent folders let the work proceed in parallel without concurrent edits to shared files.
events.alternatives: Requested model/effort are configuration records, not runtime attestation, cost or timing measurements.
events.outcome: Each worker returned implementation, meaningful checks and known verification gaps.

events.title: Use functioning local demonstrations
events.decision: Retain keyboard destination navigation, simulate market/order state, and validate workshop/session capacity and quantities.
events.why: The controls should demonstrate actual product behaviors.
events.alternatives: Market values and products are fictional. There are no exchange, payment or booking integrations.
events.outcome: Workers reported passing targeted behavior tests; integrated and browser checks are recorded separately.

events.title: Show a concise visual story
events.influence: User request for what happened and why
events.decision: List all three demos on the main page and explain six consequential choices in one public story.
events.why: Make the range and rationale visible without technical downloads.
events.alternatives: Detailed records remain source documentation. No hidden reasoning trace is presented.
events.outcome: Gallery, README links and a six-step public story were implemented.

events.title: Check working states and actual screen widths
events.influence: Kishu evidence guidance and Impeccable craft review
events.tool: Node test runner; Codex browser controls; Impeccable detector
events.decision: Exercise the real controls and inspect all five pages at phone, tablet and desktop widths.
events.why: A visual showcase also needs readable layouts and credible behavior.
events.alternatives: Unit checks alone do not establish rendered quality; static screenshots alone do not verify transitions.
events.outcome: 38 site tests passed. Resource checks passed. Browser flows confirmed scene changes, simulated orders and booking review; responsive testing found and fixed a narrow-screen minimum-width issue.

events.title: Review the finished collection in a fresh context
events.influence: Kishu model roles; Impeccable finish review
events.tool: collaboration.spawn_agent; local image and source inspection
events.decision: Pass the renders, scoped directions and observed checks to a fresh reviewer with no inherited chat history.
events.why: Independent review can challenge the builder’s assumptions before publication.
events.alternatives: The reviewer had no browser and made no pixel-parity claim against unavailable historical comps.
events.outcome: All sixteen required captures were inspected; disposition ship, no material fixes.
